description: Frontend UI: YOUR ONGOING AUCTIONS section with cards (Continue Auction, View Details), Rejoin Existing Auction card, host connection panel, host controls additions (View Auction History, Return to Dashboard), paused notice, header exit fix, and headless responsive UI tests. Depends on FEAT-003 (types, services, stores, ConnectionStatus). See plan.md items 9-11. Read frontend/AGENTS.md and the relevant node_modules/next/dist/docs guide first. Follow the ui-ux-pro-max checklist: SVG/lucide icons (no emoji), cursor-pointer, visible focus, 4.5:1 contrast, transitions 150-300 ms, prefers-reduced-motion, responsive at 375/768/1024/1440, no horizontal scroll.
steps: Create frontend/src/components/home/OngoingAuctionsSection.tsx (heading 'YOUR ONGOING AUCTIONS'; loads roomService.myRooms() on mount and on window focus/online; skeleton, empty state, retryable error; independent of the profile Promise.all) and OngoingAuctionCard.tsx (auction name, room code, team count, status badge with the 7 labels, round/category via potLabel, current player + current bid, players sold, players remaining, last activity relative time, role 'Host' or team name; 'Continue Auction' => router.push(summary.resumePath) only; 'View Details' opens a read-only Modal fed by roomService.summary(code), no mutating request). Status labels: NOT STARTED, WAITING FOR TEAMS, RETENTION IN PROGRESS, READY TO START, LIVE AUCTION, PAUSED, COMPLETED. Completed/cancelled are never listed.

Create frontend/src/components/home/RejoinAuctionCard.tsx ('Rejoin Existing Auction': room code input uppercase, submit => roomService.rejoin(code) => router.push(resumePath); shows the server error message; sends no team name/id). Mount section + card in frontend/src/app/home/page.tsx between the primary actions grid and the lower dashboard grid.

Create frontend/src/components/auction/HostConnectionPanel.tsx (host only; rows: team name, manager username, CONNECTED/DISCONNECTED badge, last seen relative time from snapshot.teamPresence; table at >=640 px, stacked cards below; read-only, no toasts) and render it on the auction page host area and the lobby page for hosts.

frontend/src/components/auction/HostAuctionControls.tsx: add 'View Auction History' (new AuctionHistoryModal.tsx reading snapshot.activity, soldPlayers and unsoldPlayers, with 'Show earlier bids' using the existing GET /rooms/:code/history endpoint) and 'Return to Dashboard' (leaveAuction() then router.push('/home'); membership untouched). Keep End Auction behind ConfirmDialog; non-hosts see no Pause/Resume/End.

frontend/src/app/auction/[roomCode]/page.tsx and AuctionHeader.tsx: header exit goes to /home (update its title text), show a 'PAUSED - waiting for the host to resume' notice for every member while status is PAUSED, keep timer showing remainingTimeMs while paused (already in useAuctionTimer).

Create frontend/tests/ongoing-auctions-ui.mjs and frontend/tests/connection-ui.mjs with ui-harness.mjs per plan.md item 11 (375/768/1280 widths, noHorizontalScroll, request log asserts no POST/join/create on Continue or View Details). Update tests that assert old LIVE SYNC/DISCONNECTED text or old feed kinds (auction-redesign-ui.mjs, skip-vote-ui.mjs) and any other frontend test broken by FEAT-003/004; run every frontend/tests/*.mjs that previously passed.
Scan all changed files for invalid UTF-8; write new non-ASCII as \u escapes or ASCII.
acceptance_criteria: Home page shows YOUR ONGOING AUCTIONS with cards containing every required field and both actions; Continue navigates to the server-provided resumePath without calling join/create; View Details only issues GET requests
Completed/cancelled auctions never render; each of the 7 status labels renders correctly
Rejoin Existing Auction uses only the room code and shows server errors (non-member never claims a team)
Host sees per-team connection status with last seen; non-hosts do not; paused notice visible to all; Return to Dashboard works; End Auction still confirms
No horizontal scroll at 375, 768, 1280 px; typecheck, next build and all touched/new frontend tests pass
verification: cd frontend; node tests/ongoing-auctions-ui.mjs; node tests/connection-ui.mjs; node tests/auction-redesign-ui.mjs; node tests/skip-vote-ui.mjs; node tests/retention-ui.mjs; node tests/recall-ui.mjs; node tests/websocket-protocol.mjs; node tests/reconnect-protocol.mjs
findings: Ran (cd frontend): npm run typecheck PASS; npx next build PASS; node tests/ongoing-auctions-ui.mjs PASS (new; 375/768/1280); node tests/connection-ui.mjs PASS (new); auction-redesign-ui PASS (header button name changed from 'Exit' to 'Dashboard'); skip-vote-ui PASS; recall-ui PASS; websocket-protocol PASS; reconnect-protocol PASS; retention-ui FAILS with TimeoutError on 'Retain Kylian Mbappe Full' (pre-existing baseline, same as FEAT-003). UTF-8 scan clean. New: OngoingAuctionsSection/Card (+STATUS_LABELS), RejoinAuctionCard, HostConnectionPanel (home/auction/lobby), AuctionHistoryModal, lib/relativeTime. HostAuctionControls gained optional onViewHistory/onReturnToDashboard props (buttons render only when passed; auction page passes them). Auction page exit now calls leaveAuction() and goes to /home; paused notice (data-testid paused-notice) for all members; banner handles LOST/AUTH_EXPIRED. Deviation: History modal 'Sold' list is derived from snapshot.activity (SOLD entries, newest 60), not the full purchase list.
